*   **Cost of Goods Sold:** The cost of goods sold has increased from 652.8 to 687.4, eating into the marginal gain from sales.

Operating income also improved from 100.6 to 133.8.  The operating margin also improved (Operating Income / Sales), suggesting better operational efficiency.
